name: What can cause an emergency drain clog in a main sewer line?

mainEntity.name: What can cause an emergency drain clog in a main sewer line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Emergency drain clogs in a main sewer line are often caused by a combination of factors. Common culprits include tree root intrusion, which can grow into pipes and create blockages; accumulation of grease, hair, and non-flushable items over time; or even structural issues like collapsed or broken pipes. These types of clogs are particularly problematic as they can affect all plumbing fixtures in a property and often require professional intervention, such as hydro-jetting or pipe repair, to resolve. Understanding the cause is key to preventing future occurrences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Main sewer line clogs are often caused by tree roots, grease/debris buildup, or structural pipe damage, impacting all fixtures and requiring professional resolution.
